s: strI, (puri + vA NIz .) nagarI । ityamaraH । 2 । 2 । 1 ॥ (yaTA, SrIDarasvAmiDftaBfguvacanam । “nfpAvAsaH purI proktA viSAM puramapIzyate ॥”) asyA lakzaRAdi puraSabde nagaraSabde ca liKitam । tadvarRanaM yaTA, mahABArate । 3 । 15 । 5 -- 8 । “purI samantAdvihitA sapatAkA satoraRA । sacakrA sahuqA cEva sayantraKanakA taTA ॥ sopaSalyapratolIkA sAwwAwwAlakagopurA । sacakragrahaRI cEva solkAlAtAvapoTikA ॥ sozwrikA BarataSrezWa ! saBerIpaRavAnakA । satoraRANkuSA rAjan ! saSataGnIkalANgalA ॥ saBuSuRqyaSmaguqakA sAyuDA saparasvaDA । lohacarmmavatI cApi sAgniH saguqaSfNgikA ॥” “patAkA DvajAYcalaH । toraRAni bahirdvArARi । cakrARi yoDagaRAH । huqAstadASrayasTAnAni BAzAyAM burujsaMjYAni । anye tu viRmUtrotsarjjanaSfNgARi huqA ityAhuH udAharanti ca । ‘kalyante huqaSfNgARi raTasyopari sUriBiH । viRmUtrasparSaSudDyarTaM karAdisparSa udyate ॥’ iti ॥ yantrARa AgneyOzaDabalena dfzatpiRqotkzepaRAni mahAnti BAzAyAM kAmAnsaMjYakAni । kzudrARi sIsagulikotkzepaRayantrARi vandUksaMjYakAni । KanakAH suraNgadvArA guptamArgakarttAraH ॥ upaSalyAH lohamuKAH kIlAH tadyuktAH pratolyo raTyAmArgA yasyAM sA । awwAlakAH uBarigfhAH । gopurARi puradvArARi । sAwwAni awwena annena sahitAni awwAlakAdIni yasyAM sA । sAwweti viSezaRaM upaSalyasya grAmAntasya raTyAyAScAvftyA sambaDyate । cakragrahaRI sanyanigrAhikA morccA iti mlecCaprasidDA । solkAlAtAvapoTikA solkamalAtaM jvAlAsahitamulmukaM yasyAM sA solkAlAtA iti kecit । avabadDAH poTikA yantrabadDAH kAzWapAzARAdayo ripURAmuparipAtanAya vasyAmiti prAYcaH । ulkevolkA prARaharatvAt yantrotkzipto golaH । alAtaM sakAzWadaRqalohamayamAgneyaM praharaRaM bARa iti BAzAyAM prasidDam । tayorapratyAKyeyagatyorapi poTikA pAtayitryaH mantramayyaH SaktayaH karRAyendradattaSaktisadfSA tadyuktAH solkAlAtAvapoTikA ॥ * ॥ uzwrikA mfccarmmamayAni BARqAni । sarzwiketi pAWe fzwaya AyuDaviSezAH ॥ * ॥ aSmaguqakAH varttulIkftAH pAzARAH । lohamayAni carmmARi kamaWapfzWAkArARi prahAravArakARi QAla iti praKyAtAni । sAgniH AgneyOzaDasahitA guqAH golakAH । SfNgikAstadutkzepakayantrARi । SatrURAmupari pAtanAya tapto guqo dravIBUto yatra SiKare sTApyate tatsahitetyanye ॥” iti nIlakaRWakftaBArataBAvadIpanAmawIkA ॥
m: पुरी (ई), f. a fortress, castle, town, TĀr.; MBh. &c.
N. of a town (the capital of Kaliṅga, noted for the worship of Jagan-nātha or Kṛṣṇa, IW. 244 n. 1)
the sanctuary or adytum of a temple, Inscr.
पुरी the body, BhP.
N. of one of the 10 orders of mendicants (said to be founded by disciples of Śaṃkara, the members of which add the word पुरी to their names), W.
पुरी f. See under 2. पुर.
a: पुरी — 1 A city, town; शशासैकपुरीसिव R. 1. 30; पुरीमवस्कंद लुनीहि नंदनं Śi. 1. 51. --2 A stronghold. --3 The body. --Comp. --मोहः the Dhattūra plant.

k.v: पूः स्त्री पुरीनगर्यौ वा पत्तनं पुटभेदनम्. स्थानीयं निगमोऽन्यत्तु यन्मूलनगरात्पुरम्.।

s: puM, klI, (purIM SarIraM tanotIti । tana duY vistAre + kvip । “gamaH kvO .” 6 । 4 । 40 । ityatra “gamAdInAmiti vaktavyam .” iti vArttikoktyA anunAsikalopaH । tugAgamaSca । puriM tanotIti vAkye “nahivftivfzivyaDirucisahitanizu kvO .” 6 । 3 । 116 । iti pUrvvapadasya dIrGaH .) antram । A~ta iti KyAtam । antati vaDnAti kAlaKaRqAdi antraM atibanDe nAmnItiraH । puriH SarIraM tanotIti purItat kvip vanatanAdyanimAmiti nalope svasya taniti tan nipAtanAdikArasya dIrGaH । antrasAhacaryyAt klIvatvam । purItadastriyAmiti vAcaspatiH । ityamaraBaratO ॥
m: पुरीतत् m. n. (fr. 3. पुर्, or पुरी + √ तन्?) the pericardium or some other organ near the heart
the intestines, VS.; AV.; ŚBr.; KauṣUp. (cf. परी-तत् and पुलीतत्).
a: पुरीतत् — m., n. [पुरीं देहं तनोति तन् क्विप्] 1 A particular intestine near the heart; यदा मनः पुरीतति प्रविशति T. S. --2 The entrails in general; (also पुरितत्, but it appears to be a wrong form).

k.v: अन्त्रं पुरीतद्गुल्मस्तु प्लीहा पुंस्यथ वस्नसा। स्नायुः स्त्रियां कालखण्डयकृती तु समे इमे॥
